FULL TEXT:
ONGC Tripura Power Company Limited (OTPC)
Job Description
Position Lead – Civil Maintenance - One Position
Place of Posting Plant Site at Palatana (Tripura)
Qualification BE / B. Tech (Civil) with at least 60% marks from a recognized Board /
Institution
Experience Minimum 03 Years of post-qualification experience in the relevant area
Industry Type Power Sector
Compensation Attractive
Job Description • To exercise general control over all the civil & structural activities in
township and Plant operation & maintenance.
• To extend full cooperation and coordinate all activities related to
township and Plant construction and maintenance
• Coordination and persuasion with the contractor and management
for the procurement & service pertaining to civil dept.
• Co-ordinate with mechanical, electrical, C&I, operation dept and
other relevant department related to various equipment, systems in
plant and Facility management at Township.
• Responsible for the horticulture and green-field development work.
• To prepare scope, BOQ, technical specification and estimate of any
job and raise purchase request (PR) for the same.
• Ensure availability in time and proper utilization of construction
material, manpower and equipment.
• Co-ordinating with contractor and sub-contractors for deploying
workmen and materials as per work order and execute the work as
per design, drawings and relevant codes (IS codes and other
applicable codes & standards)
• Optimization of cost during procurement and work execution.
• Compliance with plant safety protocol and environment regulation
and other relevant statutory guidelines.
• To address all such work assigned time to time related to Civil
Function.
• Measurement and bill certification of civil works.
Required Profile • Should have relevant experience, preferably in Power Plant
• Should have good analytical ability so as to identify the problems in
incipient stage, analyze and take corrective actions.
• Strong communication, interpersonal and diagnostic & trouble
shooting skills
